response.justification: While Bogdan Szabo demonstrates exceptional software engineering credentials with 20+ years of experience and clear principal-level capabilities, this role requires specialized hardware architecture and AI accelerator expertise that is not evident in the resume. The position demands deep knowledge of SoC modeling, IP design, deep learning workload optimization, and GPU architecture—domains where the candidate has no documented experience. His recent work in AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq relates to software agents rather than hardware optimization for AI training/inference, representing a fundamental domain mismatch despite strong general technical abilities.
strengths: 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience with demonstrated staff/principal-level contributions across multiple companies
Strong performance optimization background including low-latency systems, async I/O optimization, and caching strategies at Dunnhumby
Hardware-adjacent experience including robotic arm development, measurement software (NI LabWindows), and systems-level DevOps infrastructure
concerns: No visible experience with SoC and IP modeling, semiconductor design fundamentals, or hardware architecture—core technical requirements for this role
Absence of deep learning, neural network optimization, or AI accelerator performance expertise despite recent AI infrastructure work being software-focused
Career trajectory exclusively in software domain with no evidence of transitioning toward hardware systems, GPU architecture, or accelerator performance analysis

key_factors.factor: Deep learning and AI accelerator optimization knowledge
Years of experience and proven principal-level technical leadership
